title: 2027-2034 Wright-Patterson Air Force Base Multiple Award Construction Contract (MACC)
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE > DEPT OF THE AIR FORCE > AIR FORCE MATERIEL COMMAND > AIR FORCE LIFE CYCLE MANAGEMENT CENTER > FA8601  AFLCMC PZIO
description: This is a follow-on Multiple Award Construction Contract (MACC) Indefinite-Delivery Indefinite-Quantity (IDIQ) contract for design-build, design-bid-build, and Progressive Design Build (PDB) construction projects, which are specific to WPAFB, and applicable to individual Task Orders. Work will consist of a broad range of maintenance, repair, alteration and/or new construction work on various real property. Type of work the contractor can expect (not inclusive): new construction of buildings and structures; alteration and repair of buildings, structures, roads, airfields, ground, roofs; specialty construction; utilities; and miscellaneous services including remediation/hazardous waste removal (i.e. asbestos, lead paint etc.). Contractor efforts may also include design/build from concept to 100% design. Amendment 0001 incorporates the most recent round of Requests for Information (RFIs) and updates Attachments 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 9, 10. Attachment 4 is removed from the solicitation. Remaining open and unanswered RFIs will be addressed in another amendment to the solicitation.
